system.description: Defenders of Creation must have some method for discerning who is and who is not a foe. After all, the techniques of a Golden Janissary have little effect against creatures born in the light. Their training gives them the knowledge necessary to sense the flow of Essence through a body and know whether that creature belongs in Creation. Once activated, this Charm allows the martial artist to detect at a touch whether or not her special combat skills will affect a given target (i.e., whether a target is a creature of darkness). Merely touching a creature is enough to make a judgment, though an attack of some kind is necessary when the target tries not to be touched (almost always during battle). Against creatures using appropriate supernatural deception, the character adds her Essence in dice to the (Perception + Investigation) roll to oppose that effect. The martial artist must touch the target with an unarmed strike (not a weapon--even a form weapon) in order to use this Charm.
